Your docs keep piling up. Your knowledge keeps scattering.
OpenViking Compile turns scattered context into structured knowledge.
All your data lives in OpenViking's context tree.
Choose Wiki, and describe what you need in one line.
Then pick the source folders from the context tree.
Compile reads, extracts, and merges in the background,
then writes the results back to the context tree.
Scattered files become an interlinked Wiki.
It also catches conflicts across sources, automatically.
Review them on the Kanban board, and the fix is written back to the Wiki.
Where the conflicts are, and why: it's all clear on the board.
Switch the Skill, and you get a different output: a knowledge Wiki, a daily report, or a team playbook.
Compile runs continuously, so knowledge stays fresh: scheduled updates, incremental builds, version control.
OpenViking Compile. Turn any context into the knowledge you need.
